# KRA-20 formulation baseline

Generated by `generator.rs.txt` as an uncommitted integration test against detached
baseline commit `4fc8313`, using `cargo test -p krausen-app --test
zz_baseline_golden -- --nocapture` and an in-memory SQLite database. The generator
uses fixed workspace, actor, credential and equipment profile IDs. Recipe creation
uses the baseline API's generated ID; profile timestamps are captured in the fixture
and reconstructed in verification. Neither is synthesized into the v1 context.

`baseline_4fc8313_context.pretty.json` is the raw v1 context value; its canonical
JSON digest is in `baseline_4fc8313_digest.txt`. Its `applied_defaults` key is
absent. The policy source identity is the baseline implementation's SHA-256 over
`formulation.rs`, `style_reference.rs`, `mapping/calculation.rs`, `validation.rs`,
`brewery.rs`, and `canonical_json.rs`, in that order. Numeric targets, validation,
and style comparison are separate baseline output files. Engine build identity is
specific to the toolchain used to generate this evidence.
